## Architecture and inspected areas

- **Framework and model pools:** `CoscientistFramework` orchestrates literature, generation, reflection, ranking, evolution, proximity, meta-review, supervisor, and final report. Its per-role defaults select paid OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic models; some generation/evolution choices are random rather than task-qualified. [Defaults](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/framework.py#L34-L122) · [generation dispatch](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/framework.py#L216-L257).
- **Supervisor:** a LangGraph node receives the last two meta-reviews, action history, hypothesis and match counts, Elo/diversity trajectories, and literature progress. It extracts a decision/reasoning pair from prose and invokes one of six framework actions until a final report. Invalid actions assert; the main loop has no independent action ceiling. [State and parser](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/supervisor_agent.py#L22-L147) · [decision prompt](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/prompts/supervisor_decision.md#L15-L119) · [loop](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/framework.py#L445-L467).
- **Research and evidence:** goal decomposition feeds parallel GPT Researcher Markdown reports to synthesis. One failed subtopic fails its batch; reports have no normalized claim/source provenance at this seam. The configuration selects Tavily retrieval, OpenAI embeddings, and provider-specific model routes. [Research graph](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/literature_review_agent.py#L18-L168) · [provider configuration](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/researcher_config.json#L1-L16).
- **Prompts and scientific agents:** generation supports independent and ten-turn-capped collaboration; reflection has desk rejection, causal simulation, assumption decomposition and deep verification; evolution mixes top-rated and random seeds. [Generation](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/generation_agent.py#L52-L235) · [reflection](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/reflection_agent.py#L122-L470) · [evolution](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/evolution_agent.py#L86-L180).
- **Ranking and proximity:** all-pairs round-robin precedes a top-`k` bracket; match outcomes and debate transcripts are retained. The bracket docstring says it does not update Elo, but the code does. Proximity clusters OpenAI embeddings with Louvain. [Ranking](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/ranking_agent.py#L207-L310) · [proximity](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/proximity_agent.py#L15-L95).
- **Viewer and operations:** a separate process writes `done.txt`/`error.log` beside goal-hash serialized state; Streamlit polls it and loads finished state. The viewer exposes supervisor rationale/point-in-time metrics, match history, and community graphs. This is viewer inspiration, not durable recovery or authenticated event replay. [Process markers](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/background.py#L19-L66) · [supervisor view](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/supervisor_page.py#L32-L139) · [tournament view](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/tournament_page.py#L124-L217) · [proximity view](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/proximity_page.py#L157-L305).
